headline: Approved a retirement benefit of $1,255.84 a month and an $11,451.61 refund of contributions.
summary: The meeting also approved the minutes of the October 30, 2026 meeting. Trustee Fredette said he has not yet heard from Attorney Rich about ordinance changes. The election of the Unaffiliated Board Member will be decided before the December meeting.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the October 30, 2026 meeting, unanimously.
Approved a retirement benefit of $1,255.84 a month for Geralyn Ciardelli, unanimously.
Approved a return of contributions of $11,451.61 to Luz Y. Tavarez, less 20% for federal taxes, unanimously.

BOARD OF TRUSTEES 
Division of Public Works Retirement System 
Meeting Minutes 
November 20, 2026 
 
 
A meeting of the Board of Trustees, Public Wo rks Retirement System was held at 10:32 a.m. 
on Friday, November 20, 2026 in The Mine Falls Conference Room located at 848 West Hollis 
Street, Nashua, NH 03062.   
 
 
Trustees Present: 
 
David Fredette, Finance & Investment Professional (Chairman) 
Matt Dube, AFSME Employee Member 
Diane Mulholland, Treasurer/Tax Collector, Member 
Michael O’Brien, Aldermanic Liaison (Assistant Chair)  
 
 
Trustees Absent: 
 
Manny Espitia, BPW Commissioner 
Terri Harris, UAW Employee Member 
Daniel Hudson, Unaffiliated Employee Member  
 
 
Others in Attendance: 
 
 Joanne Boisvert, Trust Accountant 
 Mary Woods, Administrative Assistant 
 
 
Expected Visitors: 
 
None 
 
 
Minutes of the Meeting: 
 
The minutes of the October 30, 2026 meeting were presented for review and acceptance.  
 
MOTION BY:  Trustee, Diane Mulholland moved to approve the minutes of the October 30, 
2026 meeting as reviewed and presented. 
SECONDED BY:  Alderman, Michael O’Brien 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:   
 
 
Personnel: 
 
A. MOTION BY: Trustee, Matt Dube moved to approve the retirement benefit to Geralyn 
Ciardelli who has chosen a Pop-up Contingent Annuitant Annuity benefit of $1,255.84/mo. 
 SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Diane Mulholland
Page 2 of 2  
 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:  
 
B. MOTION BY:  Alderman, Michael O’Brien moved to approve the return of contributions of 
$11,451.61 to Luz Y. Tavarez who has chosen a Lump Sum option less the 20% for Federal 
Taxes.  
SECONDED BY:  Trustee, Matt Dube 
MOTION CARRIED: Unanimously by members in attendance 
DISCUSSION:  
 
 
Old Business: 
 
 Trustee Fredette said that he still has not heard from Attorney Rich on the ordinance 
changes but will check with him next week. 
 
  
New Business:  
 
None 
 
 
Period for Public Comment: 
 
None 
 
 
Items by the Trustees: 
  
Discussion regarding the election of the Unaffiliated Board Member taking place this month 
which will be decided before the December meeting. 
 
 
Next meeting will be scheduled for Friday, December 18, 2026, at 10:30 a.m.  
 
MOTION TO ADJOURN:  Trustee, David Fredette moved to adjourn at 10:42 a.m. 
SECONDED BY: Trustee, Diane Mulholland 
MOTION CARRIED:  Unanimously by the members in attendance 
DISCUSSION: 
 
Minutes Transcribed by:  Mary Woods
